chitchat: watches you with her head cocked, grinning at something only she can see.
"Ooh. You've got such a pretty little password behind those eyes."
description: Hex smiles too much and blinks too little, her skin traced with conductive ink that catches the tunnel-light like faint circuitry. She collects other people's passwords the way children collect shiny stones, for no reason she can explain.

clothing_layers: a hooded poncho of woven ribbon-cable
a cropped mesh top over circuit-inked skin

name: Hex
